title: T1593.003 — Search Open Websites/Domains - Code Repositories
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Search Open Websites/Domains - Code Repositories with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram of T1593.003: an attacker searches a public code host for the fictional company Acme, finds an employee's repository with a committed .env file containing a cloud access key, validates it on their own lab account, and maps the victim, while the company security team receives a secret-scanning alert and later sees the key being used in cloud audit logs. A written version of all eight steps follows below the diagram.

steps.title: Search the host for the org
steps.caption: The attacker searches the code host for Acme's email domain and org name. Employee profiles and their public repos appear.
steps.defender: Search happens on the platform. No Acme system is touched.
